meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过调用论文搜索工具，按关键词、作者或主题在 arXiv、PubMed、IEEE Xplore 等多个平台查找学术论文。
howto.when: 当你说“搜索论文”“查找研究论文”“搜索 arXiv”等请求查文献时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索arXiv上关于Transformer的论文
say.note: 会调用工具查找相关预印本。

say.note: 会在生物医学库中检索。

say.text: 在IEEE Xplore里找5G相关的学术文章
say.note: 使用工程领域数据库搜索。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use paper-search tools to find academic papers by keywords, authors, or topics across platforms like arXiv, PubMed, IEEE Xplore, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search for papers, find research papers, search arXiv, etc.
